standard.summary: REPA（Representation Alignment）在标准 diffusion loss 之外添加一个辅助 loss，让 UNet 中间层的表示与外部视觉模型（如 DINOv2/CLIP）的表示对齐，提升生成质量。
standard.effect: repa_loss_type 控制对齐方式（cosine/mse）。repa_loss_weight 控制辅助 loss 的权重。repa_target_modules 指定哪些 UNet 层参与对齐。
standard.whenToUse: 追求比标准 training 更好的生成质量和多样性时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要额外下载外部视觉模型。增加训练计算开销。

standard_en.summary: REPA (Representation Alignment) adds an auxiliary loss beside the standard diffusion loss that aligns the UNet's intermediate-layer representation with an external vision model's (DINOv2/CLIP and the like), improving generation quality.
standard_en.effect: repa_loss_type controls how the alignment is measured (cosine/mse). repa_loss_weight controls the auxiliary loss's weight. repa_target_modules names which UNet layers take part.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you are after better generation quality and variety than standard training gives.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It requires downloading an external vision model. It adds training compute.

advanced.principle: REPA 的核心思想：预训练视觉模型（如 DINOv2）的中间表示捕获了丰富的语义信息。通过让 UNet 的中间特征与这些表示对齐，UNet 可以学到更好的语义理解。repa_projection_dim 控制投影维度。softrepa 是 REPA 的改进版，使用 sigma 相关的调度策略在不同噪声级别上调整对齐强度。repa_stop_grad_target=True 时不对外部模型计算梯度。
advanced.intervention: forward pass 时同时计算 diffusion loss 和 REPA alignment loss，加权求和。
advanced.expectedImpact: 生成质量和多样性提升约 3-8%。对复杂场景改善更明显。
advanced.tradeoffs: softrepa_schedule 控制 sigma 相关的权重调度。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/repa.py → DINOv2 feature alignment → auxiliary loss

advanced_en.principle: REPA's core idea: intermediate representations of pretrained vision models (e.g. DINOv2) capture rich semantic information. By aligning the UNet's intermediate features with these representations, the UNet learns better semantic understanding. repa_projection_dim controls the projection dimension. softrepa is an improved REPA using a sigma-dependent schedule to adjust alignment strength across noise levels. With repa_stop_grad_target=True no gradients are computed for the external model.
advanced_en.intervention: During the forward pass, computes both the diffusion loss and the REPA alignment loss, combined by weighted sum.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Generation quality and diversity improve by roughly 3-8%. The improvement is more evident on complex scenes.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: softrepa_schedule controls the sigma-dependent weight schedule.
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/repa.py → DINOv2 feature alignment → auxiliary loss
